description: Cold start, 3000 PAL frames (60 s), controller 1 only: Start 300-305 (title screen to main menu), Start 620-625 (menu entry 1P, the default cursor position), Start 750-755 (PICK YOUR UNI: MIKE, the default), Start 900-905 (PICK TOUR: CRAWLER, the default and first tour), Start 1050-1055 (PICK TRACK: DRAGSTER, the default and first track of the tour), Start 1200-1205 (NOW PLAYING: Race), then Right held 1500-2999 (accelerate; the race timer starts by frame 1400) and Up held 2200-2259 while riding. Menu choices are the defaults at every screen so the path needs no cursor movement; the frame numbers were found by M1-01 frame-image dumps and leave about 100 frames of slack after each screen change. Controller 2 silent. Equivalent to tests/manifests/reference/race-crawler-dragster-3000.json.
tested_behavior: Laboratory only: repeated fresh-process runs sample identically on every declared field, and removing the riding input diverges during the riding phase (the inputs reach gameplay code). No gameplay field has a meaning yet (M1-02).

inputs.injection_point: Buttons are presented on the libretro input callback before retro_run of the frame numbered `from`..`to` (0-based frames after power-on) and withdrawn before the following frame; the core polls the controllers once per frame (R-0002 finding 6). Sub-frame timing is not available.

fields.name: wram_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the 131072-byte work RAM ($7E0000-$7FFFFF) at the end of the frame

fields.name: registers
fields.description: CPU register block at the end of the frame: pc, a, x, y, s, d, b, p, e, mdr, vcounter, hcounter, field, wai, stp

fields.name: wram_0000_0200
fields.description: Raw diagnostic range $7E0000-$7E01FF (direct page and the top of the stack area). No gameplay interpretation; M1 defines fields.
